mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals robust economic growth, enhancing corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite rising GDPC1, or if returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% triggers monetary easing, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if returns are negative despite the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) and GDPC1 (demand) jointly signal robust economic growth, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises 0.5% and GDPC1 increases 2% over the next month
failure_condition: Returns fail to follow when both proxies rise simultaneously, or if the correlation between proxies and returns is weak (R-squared < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting market overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns occur despite UNRATE rising above 6% in such a regime, or if the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in RSAFS (demand) signals robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite rising RSAFS, or if returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO crossing above 99.5 indicates robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor sentiment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are not positive when INDPRO crosses above 99.5, or if the effect is transient (decays within 30 days).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (demand) and decline in FEDFUNDS signals strong expansionary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases 5% and FEDFUNDS falls below 1.0% over the next month
failure_condition: Returns fail to follow when both proxies move as expected, or if the correlation between proxies and returns is weak (R-squared < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, FEDFUNDS falling below 0.05% signals extreme monetary accommodation, immediately lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such regimes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or if returns are negative despite the trigger.
